name: Cave Druid
summary: A guardian of the lightless world who runs tunnels, evades tremorsense, resists subterranean horrors, and assumes ooze forms.

featureOverrides.summary: Influence oozes rather than magical beasts with the normal -4 penalty.
Assume a Small or Medium ooze as beast shape III; gain ooze anatomy and immunity to poison, sneak attacks, and critical hits.
Assume a Tiny or Large ooze as beast shape IV; plant forms are unavailable.

features.name: Cavesense
features.summary: Replace Knowledge (geography) with Knowledge (dungeoneering) as a class skill and gain +2 on Knowledge (dungeoneering) and Survival.

features.name: Tunnelrunner
features.summary: Move through rubble and squeezing passages at normal speed without penalty.

features.name: Lightfoot
features.summary: You cannot be detected with tremorsense.

features.name: Resist Subterranean Corruption
features.summary: Gain +2 on saves against exceptional, supernatural, and spell-like abilities of oozes and aberrations.
